mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Verona Community Park, and if you are outside tonight, keep an eye out for the space station pass starting at 7:40 PM as it travels from over Mount Horeb toward the northeast near Madison.

On September 10th, Verona officers were dispatched to a residential burglary on Hunter's Cove Way. A 19-year-old suspect from Madison was taken into custody, and a handgun was recovered from the scene.

Today features the exciting Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival, along with live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness, and next week includes trivia at Hop Haus and Paddy Mac's.
On September 10th, police responded to a burglary in progress on Hunter's Cove Way, resulting in one arrest for burglary and recklessly endangering safety.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Really Reese's. The store is currently open and will be serving until 10 PM tonight.
